## Description {#details}

<p>Human (standard output) implementation of <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/reporter">reporter</a></span>.</p>


<p><span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/reporter-human">reporter_human</a></span> provides a concrete implementation of the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/reporter">reporter</a></span> abstract interface, formatting and presenting test results in a human-readable form. It accumulates output in an internal string buffer and writes it to the standard output stream, supporting colour-coded diagnostics (when the output is a terminal, or when forced with <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--color</span>) and multiple verbosity levels.</p>


<p>The reporter is intended for the people who read the console output. Most writes to the optional output file follow the console verbosity, so the file receives the full report only with normal or verbose verbosity; for the integration with other tools, the TAP reporter, whose output file is always complete, is the one to use.</p>


<p>The reporter is created by the runner, as selected by the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--<a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/reporter">reporter</a></span> command-line option, or by <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/runner-options/#ad22d04df014c5b0658b6e7bd239f15b0">runner_options::selected_reporter</a></span>. A different output format requires a new class derived from <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/reporter">reporter</a></span>, and an extension of the runner to create it.</p>


<p>All members are defined within the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail">micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::detail</a></span> namespace, since the reporters are internal to the framework.</p>


<p>Definition at line 106 of file <a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reporter-human-h">reporter-human.h</a>.</p>

### abort\_session() {#a66f620b093f92e0def6bf5297fb6d6ee}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">
<table class="doxyMemberLabels">
<tr class="doxyMemberLabels">

<table class="doxyMemberName">
<tr>
<td class="doxyMemberName">void micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::detail::reporter_human::abort_session (const <a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reflection/source-location">reflection::source_location</a> &amp; location, bool is_requirement)</td>

<span class="doxyMemberLabels">

</span>

</div>
<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Reports the abort of the test execution.</p>


<p>Displays the names of the open test cases not yet displayed, followed by the buffered check results, and a final <span class="doxyComputerOutput">✗ Test execution aborted at &lt;file&gt;:&lt;line&gt;</span> line, in place of the totals.</p>


<dl class="doxyParamsList">
<dt class="doxyParamsTableTitle">Parameters</dt>
<dd>
<table class="doxyParamsTable">
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">location</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>The source location of the failed requirement, or of the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/runner/#a7bc806540e65c21095ef1ea1ef970db2">runner::abort()</a></span> call.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">is_requirement</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p><span class="doxyComputerOutput">true</span> if the abort is caused by a failed requirement.</p></td>
</tr>
</table>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Returns</dt>
<dd><p>Nothing.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>Since <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a7987c7a524058211a73d048d28943fb9">end_test_case()</a></span> is not called for the running test cases, this member function writes the buffered results in its place; after a failed requirement, they end with it. As in <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a7987c7a524058211a73d048d28943fb9">end_test_case()</a></span>, they are written to the output file only with normal or verbose verbosity.</p>


<p>Unless the verbosity is silent, the names of the open test cases that were not displayed yet (all of them, with normal or quiet verbosity) are written to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span>, followed by the buffered results, so that a failure is not attributed to the previous test case. With quiet verbosity, which otherwise displays only the summary, the results are displayed as well, since the summary is never reached; this includes the passed checks, which give the context of the failure.</p>


<p>In place of the summary, a <span class="doxyComputerOutput">✗ Test execution aborted at &lt;file&gt;:&lt;line&gt;</span> line is then written, as the summary is, unless the verbosity is silent, to the output file and to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span>. After a failed requirement, the location is the same as in the failure line, which is already marked <span class="doxyComputerOutput">- test execution aborted</span>; for an explicit call of <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/runner/#a7bc806540e65c21095ef1ea1ef970db2">runner::abort()</a></span>, it is the only report of the abort.</p>


<p>The buffer is then cleared, so that its results are not written again, should the abort handler throw an exception that the application catches.</p>

<p>This member function marks the beginning of a test case. For a nested test case, the results of the checks already performed by the outer test case, if any, are written first (see <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/reporter/#a5cf73aaf67484b50c25ef42363d49337">commit_outer_results()</a></span>), so that the output follows the execution order.</p>


<p>A <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"• &lt;name&gt;"</span> line, indented according to the nesting depth, is written to the output file (if open) and, with verbose verbosity, to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span>, preceded by an empty line when <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/reporter/#a38252f2ef24feabcb7f55e7bdac30bd2">add_empty_line_</a></span> is set.</p>

<p>Unless verbosity is silent, prints a summary line to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span> (and to the output file if open) showing the total number of successful checks, failed checks, executed test cases, and test suites, each count followed by the number skipped by the filter (only when not zero), together with the elapsed time when timing data is available. The line is prefixed with a green <span class="doxyComputerOutput">✓</span> tick on success or a red <span class="doxyComputerOutput">✗</span> cross on failure, using ANSI colour codes when colour output is enabled.</p>

### end\_suite() {#af8dc976373fc0976c8486693d9b9f835}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">
<table class="doxyMemberLabels">
<tr class="doxyMemberLabels">

<tr>
<td class="doxyMemberName">void micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::detail::reporter_human::end_suite (const <a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/suite">suite</a> &amp; suite)</td>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Marks the end of a test suite.</p>


<dl class="doxyParamsList">
<dt class="doxyParamsTableTitle">Parameters</dt>
<dd>
<table class="doxyParamsTable">
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">suite</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>Reference to the test suite.</p></td>
</tr>
</table>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Returns</dt>
<dd><p>Nothing.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>With normal or verbose verbosity, this member function summarises the results of the test suite, with appropriate formatting and colour coding; for silent or quiet verbosity levels, no output is produced. An empty line is first added if the suite executed any test cases.</p>


<p>For suites without failed checks, a <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"✓ &lt;name&gt; - passed"</span> line is displayed, including the number of checks and test cases; the buffered check results are written to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span> only with verbose verbosity. Otherwise, a <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"✗ &lt;name&gt; - FAILED"</span> line is shown, detailing the number of successful and failed checks and the number of test cases, preceded by the buffered check results. The buffered results are always written to the output file. The elapsed time is appended when available.</p>


<p>Finally, the streams are flushed and the buffer is cleared.</p>

### end\_test\_case() {#a7987c7a524058211a73d048d28943fb9}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">
<table class="doxyMemberLabels">
<tr class="doxyMemberLabels">
<td class="doxyMemberLabelsLeft">
<table class="doxyMemberName">
<tr>
<td class="doxyMemberName">void micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::detail::reporter_human::end_test_case (const <a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/reporter/#a904f410e240644fa77d65e686e6fc3eb">test_case</a> &amp; test_case)</td>

</td>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Marks the end of a test case.</p>


<dl class="doxyParamsList">
<dt class="doxyParamsTableTitle">Parameters</dt>
<dd>
<table class="doxyParamsTable">
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">test_case</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>Reference to the test case.</p></td>
</tr>
</table>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Returns</dt>
<dd><p>Nothing.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>With normal or verbose verbosity, this member function summarises the outcome of the test case, with appropriate formatting and colour coding; for silent or quiet verbosity levels, no output is produced.</p>


<p>For passing test cases, a <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"✓ &lt;name&gt; - passed"</span> line is shown with the number of checks; the buffered check results are written to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span> only with verbose verbosity. A test case fails when one of its checks or one of its nested test cases failed. For failing test cases, the buffered check results are always shown (preceded, with normal verbosity, by the names of the test case and of the outer test cases, if not already displayed), followed by a <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"✗ &lt;name&gt; - FAILED"</span> line with the number of successful and failed checks, and of the failed nested test cases, when not zero. The buffered results are always written to the output file.</p>


<p>Finally, the streams are flushed and the buffer is cleared.</p>

<p>Reports a failure of a test suite outside its test cases.</p>


<p>Adds a <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"✗ &lt;message&gt; FAILED"</span> line, at the indentation of the test cases, to the output buffer, which <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#af8dc976373fc0976c8486693d9b9f835">end_suite()</a></span> displays.</p>

<p>Adds a <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"✗ &lt;message&gt; FAILED"</span> line to the output buffer, indented as the test cases of the suite, with the same colours as the failed checks; since there is no source location, no parenthesised location follows. The line is displayed by <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#af8dc976373fc0976c8486693d9b9f835">end_suite()</a></span>, with the other buffered output of the failed suite.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Reports a test case skipped by the filter.</p>


<p>Displays a <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"• &lt;name&gt; - skipped (filtered)"</span> line, indented by its nesting depth.</p>


<dl class="doxyParamsList">
<dt class="doxyParamsTableTitle">Parameters</dt>
<dd>
<table class="doxyParamsTable">
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">test_case</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>Reference to the skipped test case.</p></td>
</tr>
</table>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Returns</dt>
<dd><p>Nothing.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>As in <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a04cef97a62731931038355a1b5f23556">begin_test_case()</a></span>, for a nested test case, the results of the checks already performed by the outer test case, if any, are written first (see <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/reporter/#a5cf73aaf67484b50c25ef42363d49337">commit_outer_results()</a></span>), so that the output follows the execution order.</p>


<p>With normal or verbose verbosity, a <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"• &lt;name&gt; - skipped (filtered)"</span> line, indented according to the nesting depth, is then written to the output file (if open) and to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span>, preceded on <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span> by an empty line when <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/reporter/#a38252f2ef24feabcb7f55e7bdac30bd2">add_empty_line_</a></span> is set. For silent or quiet verbosity levels, no output is produced.</p>

### write\_buffer\_to\_console() {#ae074822d712fc3db3c09f5f2d2237072}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">

</table>
</td>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Writes the current buffered content to the console.</p>


<p>The console is the standard output stream; the buffer is written verbatim, without appending a line ending, and is not cleared.</p>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd><p>None.</p></dd>
</dl>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Returns</dt>
<dd><p>Nothing.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>This member function writes the contents of the internal output buffer to the console without appending a newline character. The buffer is not cleared; the caller is responsible for clearing it when appropriate.</p>


<p>The buffer is written with its size, not as a C string, so that a zero character in a message does not end the output.</p>


<p>Declaration at line <a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reporter-h/#l00365">365</a> of file <a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reporter-h">reporter.h</a>, definition at line <a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/files/src/reporter-cpp/#l00253">253</a> of file <a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/files/src/reporter-cpp">reporter.cpp</a>.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Writes the results of the outer test case, if any, before a nested test case begins or is skipped.</p>


<p>Called by <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/reporter/#aa5f6b45879c1e0986ce4ebf9f374a182">begin_test_case()</a></span> and <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/reporter/#a1986653001ad23e18de13822bbcd022f">skip_test_case()</a></span> of the concrete reporters, so that the output follows the execution order.</p>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd><p>None.</p></dd>
</dl>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Returns</dt>
<dd><p>Nothing.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>For a nested test case, the outer test case may have performed checks before it; their results are written first, by <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/reporter/#a844e80839c81133b52ee3beabf64d942">commit_buffer()</a></span>. For a top-level test case, the buffer is expected to be empty, since the checks are performed only by the test cases, and each one writes its results when it ends; should it not be, its content is written in the same way, rather than lost or attributed to the next test case, and the run continues.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Writes the current buffered content to the output file.</p>


<p>The buffer is written without appending a line ending, and is not cleared. ANSI colour sequences are removed, so the file receives plain text even when the console output is coloured. If no output file is open, the call has no effect.</p>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd><p>None.</p></dd>
</dl>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Returns</dt>
<dd><p>Nothing.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>Writes the contents of <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/reporter/#a0972f104175c075295a8aa385e90aad4">buffer_</a></span> to <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/reporter/#a270178ed5fbe0d3f4d72766c2984582a">output_file_</a></span> without appending a newline. If <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/reporter/#a270178ed5fbe0d3f4d72766c2984582a">output_file_</a></span> is null, the call is a no-op.</p>


<p>The buffer may contain ANSI colour sequences, added when the console is a terminal, which must not reach the file; they are removed by <span class="doxyComputerOutput">write_without_colours()</span>.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Writes formatted text to the console.</p>


<p>All reporter console output is routed through this function, so that it reaches the standard output stream via a single path, shared with the output of the user <span class="doxyComputerOutput">printf()</span> calls. Using one stream-based path keeps the reporter and user output in the same buffer, preserving their relative order.</p>


<dl class="doxyParamsList">
<dt class="doxyParamsTableTitle">Parameters</dt>
<dd>

<tr class="doxyParamItem">

</tr>
</table>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Returns</dt>
<dd><p>Nothing.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>The arguments are forwarded to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">vfprintf()</span> on <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span>. The stream is explicit, so the compiler does not rewrite the call into <span class="doxyComputerOutput">puts()</span> or <span class="doxyComputerOutput">putchar()</span>, and all console output shares the same <span class="doxyComputerOutput">FILE</span>-based path.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Writes formatted text to the output file.</p>


<p>If no output file is open, the call has no effect, so callers do not need to check <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/reporter/#a270178ed5fbe0d3f4d72766c2984582a">output_file_</a></span> themselves.</p>

<dt class="doxyParamsTableTitle">Parameters</dt>
<dd>
<table class="doxyParamsTable">
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">format</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>A <span class="doxyComputerOutput">printf()</span>-style format string.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">...</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>The arguments referred to by the format string.</p></td>

</dl>

### write\_info() {#aeafdc8e05a6d80d9445f17ff354ee215}

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Writes the informational (non-result) lines to the console and to the output file.</p>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd><p>None.</p></dd>
</dl>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Returns</dt>
<dd><p>Nothing.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>Constructs and emits two informational lines, each prefixed by <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/reporter/#a324aa273975068c140ab6eecc7e722c9">comment_prefix()</a></span>: the first lists the program name (without the path) and any command-line arguments; the second identifies the compiler (Clang, GCC, or MSVC) together with the version string, floating-point availability on bare-metal targets, exception support, and any active debug or trace macros. Both lines are written to the output file when one is open, and to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span> when the verbosity is <span class="doxyComputerOutput">normal</span> or <span class="doxyComputerOutput">verbose</span>, except when both <span class="doxyComputerOutput">MICRO_OS_PLUS_STARTUP_ENABLED</span> and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">MICRO_OS_PLUS_DIAG_TRACE_ENABLED</span> are defined, since the startup code already displays this information.</p>

### write\_line() {#aa97f2ba65009154090dc68e42c94db71}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">
<table class="doxyMemberLabels">
<tr class="doxyMemberLabels">

<table class="doxyMemberName">
<tr>
<td class="doxyMemberName">void micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::detail::reporter::write_line (bool to_console, const char * format, ...)</td>
</tr>
</table>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Writes formatted lines to the output file and, when requested, to the console.</p>


<p>The text is formatted once, and the same text is written to the output file, if open, and, when <span class="doxyComputerOutput">to_console</span> is true, to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span>. As in <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/reporter/#a37cba38a47d66a928a936ee081c6d88c">write_buffer_to_file()</a></span>, the ANSI colour sequences are removed from the file copy, so a console line with colours and its plain file line are written by one call. The format normally ends with a line ending; any empty line or buffered output that precedes the console line is written by the caller, before this call.</p>


<dl class="doxyParamsList">
<dt class="doxyParamsTableTitle">Parameters</dt>
<dd>
<table class="doxyParamsTable">
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">to_console</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>Whether to write the text to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span> as well.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">format</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>A <span class="doxyComputerOutput">printf()</span>-style format string.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">...</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>The arguments referred to by the format string.</p></td>
</tr>
</table>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Returns</dt>
<dd><p>Nothing.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>The text is formatted with <span class="doxyComputerOutput">vsnprintf()</span> into a local array, which holds the usual lines without an allocation; a longer text, for example with a long test name, is formatted again, from a copy of the arguments, into a string of the exact length. The array is kept small, since the lines that end the nested test cases are written at the deepest point of the stack. The text is then written with its length to the output file, without the colour sequences (see <span class="doxyComputerOutput">write_without_colours()</span>), and, when requested, to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span>, unchanged. When there is nowhere to write, or the formatting fails, nothing is written.</p>

### commit\_buffer() {#adf27b1d3d7cb168f295e4bf198bb0dbf}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">
<table class="doxyMemberLabels">
<tr class="doxyMemberLabels">
<td class="doxyMemberLabelsLeft">
<table class="doxyMemberName">
<tr>
<td class="doxyMemberName">void micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::detail::reporter_human::commit_buffer (void)</td>
</tr>
</table>
</td>
<td class="doxyMemberLabelsRight">
<span class="doxyMemberLabels">
<span class="doxyMemberLabel virtual">virtual</span>
</span>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Writes the results buffered for the outer test case before a nested test case begins.</p>


<p>Keeps the report in execution order, with the checks of the outer test case before the nested test case.</p>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd><p>None.</p></dd>
</dl>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Returns</dt>
<dd><p>Nothing.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>The buffered results of the outer test case are written to the output file, with normal or verbose verbosity (as <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a7987c7a524058211a73d048d28943fb9">end_test_case()</a></span> does), and, with verbose verbosity, to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span>. With normal verbosity, they are written to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span> only when they include a failure, preceded by the name of the outer test case, which this verbosity otherwise displays only when the test case ends. The buffer is then cleared, so that the nested test case starts with an empty buffer, and the remaining results of the outer test case are written by its <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a7987c7a524058211a73d048d28943fb9">end_test_case()</a></span>.</p>


<p>With normal verbosity, the passed checks committed here are not displayed, even if the outer test case fails later; the output file always contains them.</p>

### display\_open\_names() {#af17a48a165abd908031ddc3a0821f81e}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">
<table class="doxyMemberLabels">
<tr class="doxyMemberLabels">

<td class="doxyMemberName">void micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::detail::reporter_human::display_open_names (void)</td>
</tr>
</table>
</td>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Displays the names of the open test cases not yet displayed.</p>


<p>With normal verbosity, the test case names are displayed only for failures; a failure in a nested test case also fails the outer ones, so their names are displayed first, outermost first, to show where the failure is.</p>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd><p>None.</p></dd>
</dl>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Returns</dt>
<dd><p>Nothing.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>Walks <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#aedc59a778d399a2f2b7bb37bb643483d">open_test_cases_</a></span> from the outermost test case and displays, on <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span>, the indented <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"• &lt;name&gt;"</span> line of each one whose name was not displayed yet, marking it as displayed. An empty line is written before the first name, unless <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/reporter/#a38252f2ef24feabcb7f55e7bdac30bd2">add_empty_line_</a></span> is set, in which case the caller has already written it.</p>

<td class="doxyMemberName">void micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::detail::reporter_human::output_fail_prefix (const std::string &amp; message, const bool has_expression, const <a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reflection/source-location">reflection::source_location</a> &amp; location, const <a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/reporter/#a904f410e240644fa77d65e686e6fc3eb">test_case</a> &amp; test_case)</td>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Outputs the prefix for a failing condition.</p>


<dl class="doxyParamsList">
<dt class="doxyParamsTableTitle">Parameters</dt>
<dd>
<table class="doxyParamsTable">
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">message</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>The message to display.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">has_expression</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>Whether the failure is associated with an expression.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">location</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>The source location of the failure.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">test_case</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>The test case that owns this check.</p></td>
</tr>
</table>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Returns</dt>
<dd><p>Nothing.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>This member function outputs the prefix for a failing check result, indented one level deeper than the test case. The prefix includes a cross symbol (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">✗</span>), an optional message, and the label "FAILED", both symbol and label in the fail colour. The source location (file name and line number) follows, after an opening parenthesis; when the failure has an expression, a comma separator is added, so that the expression follows inside the parentheses.</p>

<p>Outputs the suffix for a failing condition.</p>


<dl class="doxyParamsList">
<dt class="doxyParamsTableTitle">Parameters</dt>
<dd>
<table class="doxyParamsTable">
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">location</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>The source location of the failure.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">kind</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>The kind of the check; for <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/#a0726a1bc3b6f16245cb8a4b42fe0e70caba12fb48e2d23bb2bd2819f64d02ec7e">check_kind::requirement</a></span>, the effect that follows (the test case is stopped, or the test execution is aborted) is displayed.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">test_case</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>The test case that owns this check.</p></td>

<dl class="doxySectionUser">

<p>This member function outputs the suffix for a failing check result by closing the parenthesis, appending, if the check is a requirement, the effect that follows, and then appending <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/#a18e81b3839468cd82ad9c394d88a0e02">endl</a></span>, which adds a line ending. As for a pass, the streams are flushed when the test case ends.</p>


<p>The effect depends on the build, as in <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/check-result">check_result</a></span>: with exceptions, only the test case is stopped (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">" - test case stopped"</span>), and the run continues with the next test case; without, the test execution is aborted (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">" - test execution aborted"</span>).</p>

<p>This member function outputs the prefix for a passing check result, indented one level deeper than the test case. The prefix includes a tick symbol (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">✓</span>), in the pass colour, and, if provided, the associated message. <div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Formats the elapsed time of a suite or of the session.</p>


<p>The text is appended to the summary lines by the concrete reporters, in the form <span class="doxyComputerOutput">", time: 1.234 ms"</span>; it is empty when the stopwatch has no elapsed time, so that the summary lines remain identical on the platforms without a clock.</p>


<p>The array has a fixed size, known at compile time, so that the compiler can verify that the text is never truncated.</p>


<dl class="doxyParamsList">
<dt class="doxyParamsTableTitle">Parameters</dt>
<dd>
<table class="doxyParamsTable">
<tr class="doxyParamItem">

</tr>
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">message</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>The character array that receives the null-terminated text.</p></td>
</tr>
</table>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Returns</dt>
<dd><p>Nothing.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>The elapsed time, in microseconds, is displayed in milliseconds, with three decimals. When it is zero, either because the stopwatch has no readings or because the interval was shorter than a microsecond, the text is empty.</p>

<p>Formats the totals of the test session.</p>


<p>The text is the part of the session summary line common to the concrete reporters, in the form <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"7 checks passed, 1 failed, in 3 test cases, 2 test suites"</span>; the numbers of test cases and of suites skipped by the filter follow the respective counts, as <span class="doxyComputerOutput">", 1 skipped"</span>, only when not zero. The label (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">Total:</span> or <span class="doxyComputerOutput">total:</span>), the markers, and the elapsed time are added by the callers.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Formats the totals of a suite.</p>


<p>The text is the part of the suite result line common to the concrete reporters: <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"7 checks in 3 test cases"</span> for a passed suite, and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"6 checks passed, 1 failed, in 3 test cases"</span> for a failed one; the number of test cases skipped by the filter follows, as <span class="doxyComputerOutput">", 1 skipped"</span>, only when not zero. The status, the enclosing markers, and the elapsed time are added by the callers.</p>


<dl class="doxyParamsList">
<dt class="doxyParamsTableTitle">Parameters</dt>
<dd>
<table class="doxyParamsTable">
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">suite</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>The suite that ended.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">message</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>The character array that receives the null-terminated text.</p></td>
</tr>
</table>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Returns</dt>
<dd><p>Nothing.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>A passed suite has no failed checks, so only the number of checks is shown.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Formats the totals of a test case.</p>


<p>The text is the part of the test case result line common to the concrete reporters: <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"7 checks"</span> for a passed test case, and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"6 checks passed, 1 failed"</span> for a failed one, followed by the number of failed nested test cases, as <span class="doxyComputerOutput">", 1 test case failed"</span>, only when not zero, since a test case may fail because of a nested one alone. The status and the enclosing markers are added by the callers.</p>
